#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long lol;
vector<lol> a(20);

lol solve(lol n)
{
  if(n==0)
    return 0;
  int ind=0;
  for(int i=1;i<=16;i++)
    if(a[i]>n)
      {
	ind=i;
	break;
      }
  lol ans1=1e18,ans2=1e18;
  ans1=n/a[ind-1]*(ind-1)+solve(n%a[ind-1]);
  if(a[ind]-n<n)
    ans2=ind+solve(a[ind]-n);
  return min(ans1,ans2);
}

int main()
{
  for(int i=1;i<=16;i++)
    a[i]=a[i-1]*10ll+1ll;
  lol n;
  cin>>n;
  cout<<solve(n)<<endl;
  return 0;
}
